# 2.21.20

- **Reinforce protection** in Settings — one tap to re-arm watching after a cancelled uninstall or if you turned Accessibility back on yourself (locks, Enforcement, filter).
- Turning Accessibility back on also auto-reinforces so the phone is not left unprotected.
- Uninstall / “Get your phone back” path clarified in Settings.
- Website **Settings unlock** now pushes immediately and softens Device Owner session locks (so Settings is not still grayed by accessibility/DO), then re-locks when the window ends.
- Home edit: hold any app to move it (all layout modes); drag dock icons to reorder while editing.
